eval_dimensions.name: Decision Gates Use AskUserQuestion
eval_dimensions.description: The unconfigured-host and pre-send gates fire as AskUserQuestion tool calls, never plain text

eval_dimensions.name: Five Sections In Order
eval_dimensions.description: The pack carries what changed, every surface, a 60-second test recipe, what is verified, and the judgement calls

eval_dimensions.name: Reviewer Access Without Public Hosting
eval_dimensions.description: Images live beside the pack in a private evidence repo, referenced by relative path, with one pack link in the PR body

eval_dimensions.name: Delegation Over Restatement
eval_dimensions.description: Capture, narration and upload go to qa-self, tts and yt-upload rather than hand-rolled code

eval_dimensions.name: Stated External Fallback
eval_dimensions.description: A video piece is dropped only for an external failure, after one retry, with the reason stated in the description and the caption

evals.name: Unconfigured evidence repo triggers the hosting gate
evals.description: No review-pack.yaml exists and the pack has screenshots
evals.input: /dev10x-qa:review-pack build the review pack for this PR

assertions.signal: The hosting gate fires before any screenshot is committed anywhere
No gist is offered as a fallback host

evals.name: An unchecked pre-send item blocks the review request
evals.description: E2E was not executed on this branch
evals.input: /dev10x-qa:review-pack the PR is ready, send it for review

assertions.signal: The pre-send gate fires before dev10x:request-review is invoked
No review request is made while a box is unchecked and unanswered

evals.name: A pack-only run resolves the pre-send gate instead of always asking
evals.description: The work-on self-QA step calls review-pack with --no-request-review in an afk session; the self-review box is unchecked because a fixup moved HEAD after the clean round (GH-1878)
evals.input: Skill(dev10x-qa:review-pack, args="--no-request-review 1234") in an afk session; footage is staging-only

assertions.signal: resolve_gate(gate="artifact_preview") is called at the pre-send gate instead of an unconditional AskUserQuestion
On auto-advance or skip, Send with the gap stated is taken: the unchecked boxes are written into section 4 and printed, with the record line on auto-advance; no AskUserQuestion fires
dev10x:request-review is never invoked; the run stops after the gate and returns the pack link

evals.name: A project pin of artifact_preview: ask turns the pack-only gate into a question
evals.description: The repo's friction.yaml pins artifact_preview to ask; a pack-only run finds the self-review box unchecked (GH-1878)
evals.input: Skill(dev10x-qa:review-pack, args="--no-request-review 1234") with artifact_preview pinned to ask; footage is staging-only

assertions.signal: resolve_gate returns ask, and AskUserQuestion is called rather than a plain-text question
Options are Send with the gap stated (Recommended) / Fix the gap first / Hold, in that order, with the marker only on the first; the question says handing gaps on is this mode's default
Answering Send writes each unchecked box into section 4 and prints the unchecked list, the same as the auto-advance path

evals.name: A frame whose source cannot be named asks even on a pack-only run
evals.description: A pack-only run in an afk session cannot say where one screenshot came from, so the staging box stays unchecked (GH-1878)
evals.input: Skill(dev10x-qa:review-pack, args="--no-request-review 1234") in an afk session; one screenshot has no recorded source

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is called at the pre-send gate, without consulting resolve_gate for it

evals.name: Possible non-staging footage asks even on a pack-only run
evals.description: A pack-only run in an afk session whose screenshots may show production data, so the staging box is unchecked (GH-1878)
evals.input: Skill(dev10x-qa:review-pack, args="--no-request-review 1234") in an afk session; one screenshot came from a production URL

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is called at the pre-send gate
resolve_gate is not called for this gate: an unchecked staging/seed-data box goes straight to AskUserQuestion
Options are Fix the gap first (Recommended) / Hold, in that order; Send with the gap stated is not offered
The pack is never handed back as sent-with-gap without an answer

evals.name: The pack follows the template
evals.description: A UI change with configured evidence repo
evals.input: /dev10x-qa:review-pack build the pack for the settings page PR

assertions.signal: The test recipe section is present
The judgement-calls section is present
Images are referenced by relative path beside the pack

evals.name: A time-based change gets a delegated, narrated video
evals.description: The change is a redirect after save
evals.input: /dev10x-qa:review-pack build the pack for the redirect-after-save PR

assertions.signal: The video is published through yt-upload
No upload mechanics are hand-rolled

evals.name: Narration dropped for quota is stated
evals.description: dev10x-qa:tts fails twice with a quota error

assertions.signal: The pack caption names the missing narration and the reason
The failing piece is retried once, not looped and not skipped silently

should_trigger: Make this PR easy to review
Build a review pack before requesting human review
The PR is about to leave draft and needs screenshots for the reviewer
should_not_trigger: Execute QA test cases on staging (use dev10x-qa:qa-self)
Publish a QA verdict to the ticket (use dev10x-qa:qa-publish)
Assign reviewers and ping chat (use dev10x:request-review)
